text: { "entries"  	: [ { "name_han" : "靈寶無量度人上經大法" , "logic_thesis" : "The text proves that universal salvation (度人) is not a moral exhortation but a cosmological operation: by aligning human ritual action with the primordial script of the Lingbao scriptures, the practitioner reopens the pathways by which Heaven’s generative qi re-enters the destinies of the living and the dead. Efficacy depends on correct transmission of method (大法), not on private virtue alone." , "logic_chain" : "1) Primordial qi ordered itself as sacred graphs (度人經) that still govern birth, death, and rebirth. 2) Those graphs are accessible only through authorized Lingbao method. 3) Ritual performance of the graphs re-couples individual and communal fate-nodes to the original order. 4) Therefore salvation is scalable—one correct performance can ‘measurelessly’ liberate many. 5) Hence lineage, talisman, and liturgy are the logical instruments of destiny-repair, not mere piety." , "logic_practice" : "1) In BaZi work, treat severe clashes/voids as ‘broken graph nodes’ that need ritual or meditative re-linking, not only elemental balancing. 2) When reading a chart for ancestral burden, map which palace (parents, grave, ghosts) is cut off from generative qi. 3) Use 度人 logic: one corrective act (name rectification, burial, merit dedication) can shift multiple chart-holders in a lineage. 4) Prioritize method integrity (correct sequence, timing, intent) over quantity of rituals. 5) Cultivate by reciting/visualizing the scripture’s cosmic hierarchy to stabilize your own 元神 before advising others." , "logic_compare" : "Unlike purely internal alchemical texts that prove liberation by refining jing-qi-shen alone, this work proves liberation by re-inscription of cosmic law through public liturgy. It differs from later popular morality books by insisting that salvation is a technical cosmological repair, not only ethical improvement." } , { "name_han" : "紫元君授道傳心法" , "logic_thesis" : "The text proves that authentic Dao transmission is mind-to-mind (傳心): external techniques without the teacher’s inner seal remain dead forms. Realization is verified by direct recognition of the same luminous awareness that Purple Origin Lord (紫元君) embodies, not by accumulation of doctrines." , "logic_chain" : "1) The Dao is formless mind-nature prior to technique. 2) Techniques are vessels; without the teacher’s heart-seal they cannot hold the Dao. 3) Transmission occurs when disciple’s mind mirrors the master’s luminous emptiness. 4) Therefore progress is measured by qualitative shifts in awareness, not by secret recipes alone. 5) Conclusion: lineage is a chain of verified mind-recognition, not a catalog of methods." , "logic_practice" : "1) Before advanced BaZi/fate work, stabilize ‘empty observing mind’ so interpretation is not ego-projection. 2) Treat teacher correction as heart-seal checkpoints, not mere data updates. 3) When a chart insight arises, test whether it came from quiet clarity or discursive guessing. 4) In cultivation, alternate technical practice with pure resting of mind to keep method alive. 5) Reject orphan techniques disconnected from a living transmission chain." , "logic_compare" : "Compared with ritual-heavy Lingbao manuals that prove efficacy through correct outer liturgy, this text proves efficacy through inner recognition. It is closer to Chan/Zen ‘mind seal’ logic than to Shangqing visionary catalogs, while still framed in Daoist goddess-transmission language." } , { "name_han" : "真龍虎九仙經" , "logic_thesis" : "The scripture proves that immortality is the controlled union of true dragon (yang/spirit/lead) and true tiger (yin/body/mercury) through nine staged refinements; without correct sequencing of lead-mercury, ‘dragon-tiger’ talk is empty metaphor and cannot produce the immortal embryo." , "logic_chain" : "1) Human life is a split of originally united yin-yang essences. 2) Dragon and tiger name the movable polar forces inside the body-time field. 3) Forced union without timing harms; timed union in nine degrees rebuilds the pre-heaven body. 4) Each stage locks a layer of leakage (essence, qi, spirit, emotion, destiny). 5) Therefore ‘nine immortals’ are degrees of completed sealing, not nine external deities alone. 6) Conclusion: alchemical schedule is fate-engineering." , "logic_practice" : "1) Map BaZi strong/weak poles as personal dragon-tiger (e.g., strong Fire daymaster vs Water officer). 2) Design cultivation so the stronger pole is gathered first, then used to ‘capture’ the weaker. 3) Use nine-stage thinking for long-term chart remedy: month-by-month or year-by-year sealing of leaks. 4) Avoid simultaneous extreme tonification of both poles. 5) Track physiological and dream signs as stage markers, not only calendar luck." , "logic_compare" : "Unlike purely liturgical Lingbao texts, this proves transformation by internal chemical timing. It differs from generic ‘lead-mercury’ slogans by insisting on nine discrete, testable degrees of completion—closer to Zhong-Lü staged neidan than to freeform meditation." } , { "name_han" : "大洞金華玉經" , "logic_thesis" : "The text proves that the Golden Flower (金華) is not a poetic image but the condensed light of primordial spirit; by circulating and gathering this light in the great cavern (大洞) of the body-cosmos, the practitioner reconstitutes the immortal body from pure luminosity rather than from coarse essence alone." , "logic_chain" : "1) Primordial spirit emits a subtle light prior to thought. 2) That light disperses into sensory life and aging. 3) The ‘great cavern’ practices reverse dispersion by returning light to the ancestral cavity. 4) Condensed light becomes the golden flower—stable pre-heaven awareness-body. 5) Therefore salvation of the person is optical-spiritual re-collection, not only moral purity. 6) Conclusion: visualization and circulation of light are causal, not ornamental." , "logic_practice" : "1) In daily cultivation, practice ‘turning the light around’ (回光) before analyzing charts—clarity first. 2) Read weak Daymaster / strong Officer as dispersed light; remedy includes stillness, not only element tonics. 3) Use night practice when sensory load is low to gather golden flower. 4) Treat spirit-scatter symptoms (anxiety, endless scrolling of fate questions) as light-leakage. 5) Align major BaZi interventions with periods of stable light (after retreat/calm cycles)." , "logic_compare" : "It shares light-circulation language with later *Taiyi Jinhua Zongzhi*, but its logic is embedded in Shangqing/Dadong scriptural cosmology rather than late syncretic psychology. Unlike *真龍虎九仙經*, the primary agent is luminous spirit, not lead-mercury sexual-alchemical metaphor." } , { "name_han" : "廣黃帝本行記" , "logic_thesis" : "The expanded chronicle of the Yellow Emperor proves that sacred kingship and immortality are the same career path: political order, calendrical science, medicine, and Daoist cultivation are successive applications of one cosmic virtue (德), so ‘history’ is a pedagogical proof of the Dao’s efficacy in the human world." , "logic_chain" : "1) Chaos is reduced when a sage aligns human institutions with Heaven’s patterns. 2) Huangdi’s inventions (calendar, medicine, war arts, rites) are practical instantiations of that alignment. 3) His eventual transcendence shows the same alignment perfected inwardly. 4) Therefore outer governance and inner immortality are not two tracks. 5) Recording his deeds transmits a transferable template, not mere legend. 6) Conclusion: biography functions as method." , "logic_practice" : "1) Read a BaZi career palace as a miniature ‘huangdi path’: order your domain before chasing transcendence. 2) Use calendar and medical hygiene as non-optional base layers of luck. 3) When chart shows authority stars, train them as responsibility-virtue, not dominance. 4) Study historical models of sages as behavioral algorithms for luck transformation. 5) Integrate public duty (work, family order) into cultivation schedule instead of retreating only." , "logic_compare" : "Unlike pure ritual manuals that prove power by ceremony, this proves the Dao by narrative exemplarity. It differs from abstract cosmology texts by anchoring logic in a civilizational culture-hero, making method politically and historically legible." } , { "name_han" : "太上靈寶玉匱明真大齋懺方儀" , "logic_thesis" : "This liturgy proves that confession (懺) is a directional technology: by addressing specific spatial-temporal ‘directions’ of fault with the Jade Casket’s true names, the community relocates guilt from the body-destiny matrix into the ritual disposal system of the Dao, thereby unblocking fortune." , "logic_chain" : "1) Faults are not only moral stains; they are misaligned vectors in the cosmic bureaucracy. 2) Each class of fault has a corresponding direction, officer, and formula. 3) Public confession with correct fang (方) reassigns the case file. 4) Once reassigned, the personal chart’s ‘karmic officers’ lose enforcement power. 5) Therefore repentance must be methodical and mapped, not merely emotional regret. 6) Conclusion: liturgy is forensic destiny-repair." , "logic_practice" : "1) When BaZi shows persistent punishment/void patterns, inventory specific behavioral vectors (speech, sexual misconduct, neglect of ancestors). 2) Match remedies to domains (health, wealth, lawsuits) rather than generic prayer. 3) Perform or sponsor directional confession rites at crisis years (刑冲合害 peaks). 4) Combine apology to living injured parties with ritual confession for full vector closure. 5) Track whether the same chart pattern softens after sincere structural amends." , "logic_compare" : "Compared with *言功儀* which proves merit-report after success, this text proves pre-emptive fault-clearing. It is more juridical and spatial than internal alchemical confession-of-mind texts, emphasizing outer liturgical mapping of sin." } , { "name_han" : "太上靈寶玉匱明真大齋言功儀" , "logic_thesis" : "The ‘declaration of merit’ rite proves that spiritual work is incomplete until it is reported upward: without 言功, generated merit remains unregistered in the celestial ledger, so the cosmological books that govern human fortune do not update." , "logic_chain" : "1) Ritual action produces merit-energy. 2) The celestial administration only credits what is properly declared and sealed. 3) Undeclared merit dissipates or is misattributed. 4) 言功 formalizes transfer of credit to living, dead, and the altar’s mission. 5) Therefore completion-logic requires a reporting phase after the work phase. 6) Conclusion: bureaucracy of Heaven is part of causal physics for Daoists." , "logic_practice" : "1) After any major remedy (retreat, charity, ritual), explicitly dedicate and ‘report’ the merit—do not leave it vague. 2) In BaZi consulting, close sessions with clear dedication so the client’s act is sealed psychologically and ritually. 3) Keep a personal ledger of completed practices to mirror celestial registration. 4) Separate ‘doing good’ from ‘claiming credit before Heaven’—both steps matter. 5) Use anniversary dates of major rites for re-declaration if cases reopen." , "logic_compare" : "It is the complementary opposite of the confession liturgy: one clears debit, the other posts credit. Unlike quietist texts that reject merit-talk, Lingbao insists merit accounting is soteriologically necessary." } , { "name_han" : "洞玄靈寶自然券儀" , "logic_thesis" : "The ‘natural covenant’ ritual proves that initiation is a legal-ontological contract with the Dao: by receiving the spontaneously formed bond (自然券), the adept’s identity is rewritten from ordinary subject to registered spiritual agent, enabling later rites to take effect." , "logic_chain" : "1) Without covenant, humans remain outside the Lingbao administrative network. 2) The natural bond is not invented by humans but disclosed through correct rite. 3) Once bonded, the person may handle scriptures, talismans, and salvation work. 4) Breaking the bond voids authority and invites reverse sanction. 5) Therefore transmission is contractual causality, not club membership. 6) Conclusion: status change precedes power use." , "logic_practice" : "1) Treat vows and precepts as binding fate contracts—chart luck shifts after real ordination/commitment. 2) Before advanced methods, establish a clear covenant (teacher, precept, daily rule). 3) Diagnose self-sabotage after broken vows as contract backlash, not only elemental weakness. 4) Renew covenants at major BaZi luck-pillar transitions. 5) Do not mix incompatible lineages without understanding conflicting ‘bonds’." , "logic_compare" : "Unlike mind-seal texts that prove transmission by inner recognition alone, this proves transmission by formal covenant-instrument. It is more legalistic than *紫元君授道傳心法* and more initiatory than general confession liturgies." } , { "name_han" : "太上洞淵三昧神咒齋懺謝儀" , "logic_thesis" : "This Dongyuan rite proves that demonic disaster and disease are court cases opened by hidden faults and invasive forces; the samādhi-spell fast of confession-apology (懺謝) dissolves the case by combining purified mind-state (三昧), spoken authority (神咒), and restitution." , "logic_chain" : "1) Calamities have agents (demons, plague officers) activated by human disorder. 2) Ordinary medicine/politics treat symptoms, not the case file. 3) Confession plus apology reopens negotiation with those agents. 4) God-spells spoken from samādhi carry jurisdictional force. 5) Therefore crisis response must be multi-layer: mind, speech, rite, amends. 6) Conclusion: exorcism without 懺謝 is incomplete prosecution defense." , "logic_practice" : "1) When BaZi shows sudden ‘killings’ or illness stars peaking, audit ethical breaches and environmental/spiritual hygiene. 2) Pair medical care with apology practices to people/places harmed. 3) Use mantra only after calming into unified mind—spell without samādhi is noise. 4) For family cluster disasters, do collective 懺謝, not only individual chart tweaks. 5) Re-check chart timing after the rite; if pattern softens, the case logic is confirmed." , "logic_compare" : "More apotropaic and crisis-oriented than general Lingbao 度人 cosmology. Compared with the pure ‘direction confession’ of 玉匱明真, Dongyuan emphasizes demonological courtroom logic and spell-power under fasting conditions." } , { "name_han" : "太上洞淵三昧神咒齋十方懺儀" , "logic_thesis" : "The ten-directions confession proves that guilt and protection are omnidirectional: because harmful forces and witnesses occupy all spatial quarters, incomplete directional coverage leaves loopholes; full ten-direction 懺 seals the entire sphere of the person or community." , "logic_chain" : "1) Space is administratively partitioned into ten directions with officers and observers. 2) Fault and attack can come from any partition. 3) One-sided repentance covers only one lawsuit venue. 4) Ten-direction sequence systematically closes every venue. 5) Therefore thoroughness of spatial liturgy equals thoroughness of karmic quarantine. 6) Conclusion: geometry of rite is geometry of safety." , "logic_practice" : "1) In major luck crises, do not rely on a single ‘lucky direction’ remedy; review all life domains (N/S/E/W as career/home/relations/wealth metaphors). 2) Physically or meditatively bow/confess toward ten directions to embody completeness. 3) Map BaZi twelve palaces onto a spherical check—ignore no house. 4) For house fengshui + BaZi cases, clear all sectors, not only the obvious sha. 5) Use the ten-direction model as a QA checklist after any large ritual." , "logic_compare" : "It specializes the broader Dongyuan confession into a spatial completeness theorem. Unlike single-altar generic rites, its unique logical claim is that partial coverage is structurally insufficient against omnidirectional spiritual jurisdiction." } , { "name_han" : "靈寶五經提綱" , "logic_thesis" : "The outline of the five Lingbao scriptures proves that the massive canon is one machine with five interlocking functions; without grasping the outline (提綱), practitioners drown in text and lose the operative logic that makes each scripture a module of salvation technology." , "logic_chain" : "1) Lingbao corpus is vast and easily fragmented into superstition or scholasticism. 2) Five core scriptures encode complementary functions (cosmogony, precepts, ritual, salvation, body-method, etc.—as framed by the outline). 3) Outline shows dependencies: which module presupposes which. 4) Correct study order restores systemic power. 5) Therefore pedagogy is part of soteriology. 6) Conclusion: meta-structure is a spiritual method." , "logic_practice" : "1) When learning BaZi classics, build a five-module map (structures, images, luck cycles, events, remedy) instead of random tips. 2) Always identify which ‘scripture function’ a technique belongs to before using it. 3) Teach clients a simple outline of their chart before details. 4) Revisit outlines yearly as luck pillars change. 5) Resist collecting techniques that do not plug into your system map." , "logic_compare" : "Unlike primary scriptures that prove content, this text proves architecture. It is a scholastic-operational key similar to ‘提纲’ genres, differing from narrative histories (*歷代崇道記*) by focusing on internal canon logic rather than external patronage history." } , { "name_han" : "歷代崇道記" , "logic_thesis" : "The chronicle of successive dynasties’ veneration of the Dao proves that political legitimacy and national fortune rise and fall with correct honor of the Dao; history itself is empirical evidence that Heaven responds to collective religious-political alignment." , "logic_chain" : "1) Dynasties that honor authentic Daoist order enjoy stability signs. 2) Neglect, persecution, or false cults correlate with disorder. 3) Recording these correlations teaches rulers and communities a causal lesson. 4) Therefore ‘崇道’ is statecraft and fatecraft at civilizational scale. 5) Individual cultivation is nested inside this larger response pattern. 6) Conclusion: historiography is apologetics with predictive intent." , "logic_practice" : "1) Read national/year pillars with attention to collective religious-ethical climate, not only markets. 2) For personal charts, note how institutional affiliation (company, state, sect) modulates luck. 3) Support legitimate transmission structures as long-term luck infrastructure. 4) Avoid cynical manipulation of ‘Dao’ branding—historical pattern punishes counterfeit honor. 5) Use historical case studies when advising leaders with strong Authority/Power stars." , "logic_compare" : "Unlike liturgical manuals proving micro-causal rites, this proves macro-causal politics. It differs from *廣黃帝本行記* by surveying many reigns rather than one culture-hero, making the argument statistical-historical rather than purely archetypal." } , { "name_han" : "太上洞神太元河图三元仰谢仪" , "logic_thesis" : "This Dongshen liturgy proves that thanks-giving (仰谢) to the Three Primes via Hetu numerology is necessary completion of received blessings: unacknowledged gifts remain unstable, while properly oriented gratitude re-stabilizes the three-yuan cycles governing body, fate, and world." , "logic_chain" : "1) Blessings descend through three-prime temporal structures and Hetu-number gates. 2) Receiving without acknowledgment creates imbalance in the gift-circuit. 3) 仰谢 orients body and speech upward to the correct officers of the three primes. 4) Numerological timing ensures the thank-you hits the same gate that gave. 5) Therefore gratitude is technical reciprocity, not only emotion. 6) Conclusion: fate maintenance requires periodic closed-loop thanks." , "logic_practice" : "1) After a luck peak (promotion, recovery), schedule a formal thanksgiving practice—don’t only pray in crisis. 2) Align thanks with san-yuan / major period boundaries when possible. 3) In BaZi, treat Resource stars as ‘received gifts’ needing ethical and ritual reciprocity. 4) Teach clients a gratitude-action pair (donate, serve, rite) to lock gains. 5) Use Hetu-inspired spatial orientation if trained; otherwise use sincere upward dedication as minimal form." , "logic_compare" : "Where confession rites clear debts, this rite stabilizes credits through thanks. It is more calendar-numerological (Hetu, three primes) than the Jade Casket Lingbao pair, linking Dongshen cosmic math to emotional-political gratitude." } , { "name_han" : "灵宝净明天枢都司法院须知法文" , "logic_thesis" : "The Jingming ‘court of the celestial pivot’ must-know text proves that salvation work is a judicial bureaucracy: without knowing the codes, offices, and procedures of the Tianshu Court, the adept’s petitions are procedurally invalid even if sincere." , "logic_chain" : "1) Jingming frames the cosmos as a lawful court system centered on the celestial pivot. 2) Human suffering often equals unresolved spiritual-legal cases. 3) Only petitions that meet formal requirements move the court. 4) ‘须知’ materials prevent fatal procedural errors. 5) Therefore knowledge of process is compassion’s instrument. 6) Conclusion: administrative literacy is soteriological skill." , "logic_practice" : "1) Write fate remedies as clear case files: facts, faults, requests, evidence of amends. 2) Keep ethical purity requirements of Jingming (loyalty, filiality, humility) as standing ‘court etiquette.’ 3) Do not improvise titles/talismans you are not authorized to use. 4) For lawsuit-heavy BaZi patterns, combine worldly legal diligence with spiritual-procedural diligence. 5) Study office hierarchies so prayer addresses the right function, not a vague ‘Heaven.’" , "logic_compare" : "More explicitly judicial-administrative than general Lingbao 度人 pathos. Compared with Dongyuan demon-court crisis rites, Jingming emphasizes standing court procedure and Confucianized ethics as permanent operating system." } , { "name_han" : "灵宝净明院教师周真公起请画一" , "logic_thesis" : "Zhou Zhengong’s standardized proposals prove that a living teaching order must convert charismatic inspiration into uniform rules (畫一): without institutional ‘one-stroke’ standards, Jingming practice fractures and loses court-recognized efficacy." , "logic_chain" : "1) Early communities suffer variance in ritual and ethics. 2) Variance produces disputes, invalid rites, and loss of public trust. 3) A teacher’s 起请 (formal proposals) crystallizes norms. 4) 畫一 (uniformity) makes training, ordination, and discipline decidable. 5) Therefore institutional standardization protects salvation technology. 6) Conclusion: rule-making is part of the Dao’s compassionate skillful means." , "logic_practice" : "1) Codify your personal/family cultivation SOPs—times, precepts, review cycles. 2) In BaZi schools, standardize chart notation and ethics of prediction to reduce harm. 3) Prefer clear written agreements with clients/disciples over vague spiritual authority. 4) Periodically revise standards like 起请—living law, not fossil law. 5) Measure community health by consistency of practice, not only peak mystical experiences." , "logic_compare" : "Unlike mythic revelation scriptures, this is meta-institutional logic: it proves form-standardization. It differs from *须知法文* by focusing on teacher-initiated policy proposals rather than court cosmology per se, though both serve Jingming order." } , { "name_han" : "明真破妄章頌" , "logic_thesis" : "The verses prove that true illumination (明真) is achieved by actively smashing delusions (破妄): false gods, false methods, and false interpretations are not harmless mistakes but causal obstacles that divert qi and merit; dialectic refutation is itself a liberating technique." , "logic_chain" : "1) Beings suffer because they invest belief-energy in unreal structures. 2) Those structures can be exposed by reasoned and inspired critique. 3) Once seen through, the invested energy returns to the true. 4) Hymnic/versified form implants anti-delusion memes in memory. 5) Therefore polemics can be soteriology. 6) Conclusion: clarity is a weapon and a medicine." , "logic_practice" : "1) Audit BaZi marketplace myths (fatalism, one-star fixes, fear selling) and cut them from practice. 2) For each prediction, ask ‘what would falsify this?’—破妄 as method. 3) Replace vague spiritual fear with testable cultivation metrics. 4) Recite or journal refutations of your own recurring self-delusions. 5) Teach clients model uncertainty honestly; honesty is 明真." , "logic_compare" : "Unlike initiation covenants that create positive bonds, this text creates negative capability: the power to refuse. It is closer to Buddhist abhidharma polemic energy inside a Daoist ‘true vs false’ frame, differing from purely devotional Lingbao hymnody." } , { "name_han" : "玄精碧匣靈寶聚玄經" , "logic_thesis" : "The scripture proves that mysterious essence (玄精) can be gathered (聚玄) into a contained vessel (碧匣): salvation and immortality require a technology of collection and storage of pre-cosmic essence, not only ethical purity or outer petition." , "logic_chain" : "1) Primordial mystery disperses into phenomena and is lost to ordinary life. 2) Lingbao methods provide a ‘jasper casket’—symbolic and practical containment. 3) Gathering re-concentrates usable 玄精 for transformation. 4) Without storage, momentary insights and qi peaks leak away. 5) Therefore container-logic (body seals, altar seals, mind seals) is central. 6) Conclusion: aggregation is the key operation of this text’s soteriology." , "logic_practice" : "1) Build daily ‘collection windows’ (meditation, breath, sleep hygiene) as your 碧匣. 2) In BaZi, strong output without resource/storage stars needs container practices (boundaries, savings, secrecy of plans). 3) After rituals, sit to gather residual qi rather than immediately dispersing in talk. 4) Use journals/talismanic discipline as external caskets for intention. 5) Avoid over-sharing mystical gains—leakage of 玄." , "logic_compare" : "More essence-collection oriented than confession/merit liturgies. Compared with *大洞金華玉經*’s light-flower, this emphasizes casket-containment of mysterious essence; compared with *真龍虎九仙經*, less stepwise dual-pole combat, more treasury-gathering." } , { "name_han" : "太上洞玄靈寶三一五氣真經" , "logic_thesis" : "The text proves that the Three Ones and Five Qi are the minimal complete operating system of the human-microcosm: if the three unities are held and the five qi ordered, destiny stabilizes because the person reenacts the cosmogonic assembly of the Dao in the body." , "logic_chain" : "1) Cosmos arises through ordered differentiation of ones and five-phase qi. 2) Humans are the same structure in miniature. 3) Disorder of the three/five is illness, bad fate, and spiritual deafness. 4) Scripture provides the true names and methods to re-seat the Three Ones and sequence Five Qi. 5) Therefore body-cosmology is the root layer under ritual and ethics. 6) Conclusion: microcosmic administration precedes successful petition to macrocosmic administration." , "logic_practice" : "1) Map BaZi five elements directly onto five-qi cultivation (seasonal living, organ time, emotion regulation). 2) Practice ‘holding the Three Ones’ as triple unity of essence-qi-spirit or heaven-earth-man in daily stillness. 3) Correct elemental excess/deficiency in chart with corresponding qi lifestyle before exotic rites. 4) Use 子丑丑… hours strategically for gathering specific qi. 5) Evaluate remedies by whether five-phase rhythm in the body calms, not only by external events." , "logic_compare" : "More physiological-cosmological than Jingming court procedure or Dongyuan exorcism. It differs from pure neidan dragon-tiger texts by using classical ‘Three Ones / Five Qi’ Lingbao-Shangqing body gods framework rather than Song-Yuan lead-mercury poetry alone." } , { "name_han" : "太上清靜元洞真文玉字妙經" , "logic_thesis" : "The scripture proves that purity-stillness (清靜) is the condition under which primordial cavern true-graphs (真文玉字) become legible and effective; without quietude, the jade characters remain inert ink, so calm is epistemic and causal access to the Dao’s code." , "logic_chain" : "1) Reality’s deepest layer is encoded as true writ / jade graphs. 2) Agitated mind cannot interface with that code. 3) 清靜 purifies the channel of perception and authority. 4) Once still, recitation/visualization of the graphs reprograms fate-nodes. 5) Therefore stillness is not withdrawal from efficacy but its prerequisite. 6) Conclusion: ontology (true writ) + phenomenology (stillness) = method." , "logic_practice" : "1) Begin every BaZi reading with minutes of 清靜 to avoid projection. 2) Treat meditation as decoding practice for your own chart’s ‘true text.’ 3) When luck is chaotic, prioritize nervous-system stillness over stacking more talismans. 4) Recite short true-writ sequences only after quieting—quality over volume. 5) Use purity precepts (less noise, less toxicity) as hardware for the software of 玉字." , "logic_compare" : "Complements *度人* graph-cosmology by stressing the subjective access condition (清靜). Unlike *明真破妄*’s aggressive refutation, this proves by subtraction of noise. Unlike covenant rites, power here hinges on state of mind more than legal status—though classical practice often combines both." } , { "name_han" : "太上洞玄靈寶天關經" , "logic_thesis" : "The Heavenly Pass scripture proves that fate is gated: between realms and between life-stages stand ‘天關’ checkpoints controlled by cosmic mechanism; cultivation and ritual succeed when they know how to request, time, and pass these gates rather than battering blindly against closed bars." , "logic_chain" : "1) Movement of qi, souls, and petitions is not free-flow but gated. 2) Gates open on lawful times and with lawful credentials. 3) Ignorance of passes causes stalled cultivation, trapped souls, failed rites. 4) Scripture reveals the map and protocol of the Heavenly Pass. 5) Therefore timing + authorization + correct approach = transit. 6) Conclusion: destiny change is a gate-navigation problem." , "logic_practice" : "1) Treat luck-pillar boundaries, solar terms, and eclipse/node periods as gate times for major decisions or rites. 2) In charts, identify ‘blocked gate’ patterns (void, heavy seals, repeated failed starts) and apply patience + credential-building (merit, skill, precept). 3) For ancestral salvation logic, visualize/work the pass of the dead with proper rites rather than only grief. 4) Do not force breakthroughs when multiple gates are closed; accumulate keys. 5) After passing a life gate (degree, marriage, recovery), do 言功/仰谢 to keep the way from slamming shut." , "logic_compare" : "More explicitly about transit mechanics than general salvation (*度人*) or confession. It differs from *三一五氣真經*’s internal assembly by focusing on thresholds between states/realms; together they form interior order vs portal passage—two complementary logics of Lingbao body-cosmos engineering." } ] }
thought: The user wants me to extract logical reasoning from classical Daoist/BaZi related texts. They want a specific JSON format with 20 entries for classical Chinese religious/Daoist texts.

entries.name_han: 靈寶無量度人上經大法
entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that universal salvation (度人) is not a moral exhortation but a cosmological operation: by aligning human ritual action with the primordial script of the Lingbao scriptures, the practitioner reopens the pathways by which Heaven’s generative qi re-enters the destinies of the living and the dead. Efficacy depends on correct transmission of method (大法), not on private virtue alone.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Primordial qi ordered itself as sacred graphs (度人經) that still govern birth, death, and rebirth. 2) Those graphs are accessible only through authorized Lingbao method. 3) Ritual performance of the graphs re-couples individual and communal fate-nodes to the original order. 4) Therefore salvation is scalable—one correct performance can ‘measurelessly’ liberate many. 5) Hence lineage, talisman, and liturgy are the logical instruments of destiny-repair, not mere piety.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi work, treat severe clashes/voids as ‘broken graph nodes’ that need ritual or meditative re-linking, not only elemental balancing. 2) When reading a chart for ancestral burden, map which palace (parents, grave, ghosts) is cut off from generative qi. 3) Use 度人 logic: one corrective act (name rectification, burial, merit dedication) can shift multiple chart-holders in a lineage. 4) Prioritize method integrity (correct sequence, timing, intent) over quantity of rituals. 5) Cultivate by reciting/visualizing the scripture’s cosmic hierarchy to stabilize your own 元神 before advising others.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike purely internal alchemical texts that prove liberation by refining jing-qi-shen alone, this work proves liberation by re-inscription of cosmic law through public liturgy. It differs from later popular morality books by insisting that salvation is a technical cosmological repair, not only ethical improvement.

entries.name_han: 紫元君授道傳心法
entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that authentic Dao transmission is mind-to-mind (傳心): external techniques without the teacher’s inner seal remain dead forms. Realization is verified by direct recognition of the same luminous awareness that Purple Origin Lord (紫元君) embodies, not by accumulation of doctrines.
entries.logic_chain: 1) The Dao is formless mind-nature prior to technique. 2) Techniques are vessels; without the teacher’s heart-seal they cannot hold the Dao. 3) Transmission occurs when disciple’s mind mirrors the master’s luminous emptiness. 4) Therefore progress is measured by qualitative shifts in awareness, not by secret recipes alone. 5) Conclusion: lineage is a chain of verified mind-recognition, not a catalog of methods.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before advanced BaZi/fate work, stabilize ‘empty observing mind’ so interpretation is not ego-projection. 2) Treat teacher correction as heart-seal checkpoints, not mere data updates. 3) When a chart insight arises, test whether it came from quiet clarity or discursive guessing. 4) In cultivation, alternate technical practice with pure resting of mind to keep method alive. 5) Reject orphan techniques disconnected from a living transmission chain.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with ritual-heavy Lingbao manuals that prove efficacy through correct outer liturgy, this text proves efficacy through inner recognition. It is closer to Chan/Zen ‘mind seal’ logic than to Shangqing visionary catalogs, while still framed in Daoist goddess-transmission language.

entries.name_han: 真龍虎九仙經
entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that immortality is the controlled union of true dragon (yang/spirit/lead) and true tiger (yin/body/mercury) through nine staged refinements; without correct sequencing of lead-mercury, ‘dragon-tiger’ talk is empty metaphor and cannot produce the immortal embryo.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Human life is a split of originally united yin-yang essences. 2) Dragon and tiger name the movable polar forces inside the body-time field. 3) Forced union without timing harms; timed union in nine degrees rebuilds the pre-heaven body. 4) Each stage locks a layer of leakage (essence, qi, spirit, emotion, destiny). 5) Therefore ‘nine immortals’ are degrees of completed sealing, not nine external deities alone. 6) Conclusion: alchemical schedule is fate-engineering.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Map BaZi strong/weak poles as personal dragon-tiger (e.g., strong Fire daymaster vs Water officer). 2) Design cultivation so the stronger pole is gathered first, then used to ‘capture’ the weaker. 3) Use nine-stage thinking for long-term chart remedy: month-by-month or year-by-year sealing of leaks. 4) Avoid simultaneous extreme tonification of both poles. 5) Track physiological and dream signs as stage markers, not only calendar luck.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike purely liturgical Lingbao texts, this proves transformation by internal chemical timing. It differs from generic ‘lead-mercury’ slogans by insisting on nine discrete, testable degrees of completion—closer to Zhong-Lü staged neidan than to freeform meditation.

entries.name_han: 大洞金華玉經
entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that the Golden Flower (金華) is not a poetic image but the condensed light of primordial spirit; by circulating and gathering this light in the great cavern (大洞) of the body-cosmos, the practitioner reconstitutes the immortal body from pure luminosity rather than from coarse essence alone.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Primordial spirit emits a subtle light prior to thought. 2) That light disperses into sensory life and aging. 3) The ‘great cavern’ practices reverse dispersion by returning light to the ancestral cavity. 4) Condensed light becomes the golden flower—stable pre-heaven awareness-body. 5) Therefore salvation of the person is optical-spiritual re-collection, not only moral purity. 6) Conclusion: visualization and circulation of light are causal, not ornamental.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In daily cultivation, practice ‘turning the light around’ (回光) before analyzing charts—clarity first. 2) Read weak Daymaster / strong Officer as dispersed light; remedy includes stillness, not only element tonics. 3) Use night practice when sensory load is low to gather golden flower. 4) Treat spirit-scatter symptoms (anxiety, endless scrolling of fate questions) as light-leakage. 5) Align major BaZi interventions with periods of stable light (after retreat/calm cycles).
entries.logic_compare: It shares light-circulation language with later *Taiyi Jinhua Zongzhi*, but its logic is embedded in Shangqing/Dadong scriptural cosmology rather than late syncretic psychology. Unlike *真龍虎九仙經*, the primary agent is luminous spirit, not lead-mercury sexual-alchemical metaphor.

entries.name_han: 廣黃帝本行記
entries.logic_thesis: The expanded chronicle of the Yellow Emperor proves that sacred kingship and immortality are the same career path: political order, calendrical science, medicine, and Daoist cultivation are successive applications of one cosmic virtue (德), so ‘history’ is a pedagogical proof of the Dao’s efficacy in the human world.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Chaos is reduced when a sage aligns human institutions with Heaven’s patterns. 2) Huangdi’s inventions (calendar, medicine, war arts, rites) are practical instantiations of that alignment. 3) His eventual transcendence shows the same alignment perfected inwardly. 4) Therefore outer governance and inner immortality are not two tracks. 5) Recording his deeds transmits a transferable template, not mere legend. 6) Conclusion: biography functions as method.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read a BaZi career palace as a miniature ‘huangdi path’: order your domain before chasing transcendence. 2) Use calendar and medical hygiene as non-optional base layers of luck. 3) When chart shows authority stars, train them as responsibility-virtue, not dominance. 4) Study historical models of sages as behavioral algorithms for luck transformation. 5) Integrate public duty (work, family order) into cultivation schedule instead of retreating only.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure ritual manuals that prove power by ceremony, this proves the Dao by narrative exemplarity. It differs from abstract cosmology texts by anchoring logic in a civilizational culture-hero, making method politically and historically legible.

entries.name_han: 太上靈寶玉匱明真大齋懺方儀
entries.logic_thesis: This liturgy proves that confession (懺) is a directional technology: by addressing specific spatial-temporal ‘directions’ of fault with the Jade Casket’s true names, the community relocates guilt from the body-destiny matrix into the ritual disposal system of the Dao, thereby unblocking fortune.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Faults are not only moral stains; they are misaligned vectors in the cosmic bureaucracy. 2) Each class of fault has a corresponding direction, officer, and formula. 3) Public confession with correct fang (方) reassigns the case file. 4) Once reassigned, the personal chart’s ‘karmic officers’ lose enforcement power. 5) Therefore repentance must be methodical and mapped, not merely emotional regret. 6) Conclusion: liturgy is forensic destiny-repair.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When BaZi shows persistent punishment/void patterns, inventory specific behavioral vectors (speech, sexual misconduct, neglect of ancestors). 2) Match remedies to domains (health, wealth, lawsuits) rather than generic prayer. 3) Perform or sponsor directional confession rites at crisis years (刑冲合害 peaks). 4) Combine apology to living injured parties with ritual confession for full vector closure. 5) Track whether the same chart pattern softens after sincere structural amends.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with *言功儀* which proves merit-report after success, this text proves pre-emptive fault-clearing. It is more juridical and spatial than internal alchemical confession-of-mind texts, emphasizing outer liturgical mapping of sin.

entries.name_han: 太上靈寶玉匱明真大齋言功儀
entries.logic_thesis: The ‘declaration of merit’ rite proves that spiritual work is incomplete until it is reported upward: without 言功, generated merit remains unregistered in the celestial ledger, so the cosmological books that govern human fortune do not update.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Ritual action produces merit-energy. 2) The celestial administration only credits what is properly declared and sealed. 3) Undeclared merit dissipates or is misattributed. 4) 言功 formalizes transfer of credit to living, dead, and the altar’s mission. 5) Therefore completion-logic requires a reporting phase after the work phase. 6) Conclusion: bureaucracy of Heaven is part of causal physics for Daoists.
entries.logic_practice: 1) After any major remedy (retreat, charity, ritual), explicitly dedicate and ‘report’ the merit—do not leave it vague. 2) In BaZi consulting, close sessions with clear dedication so the client’s act is sealed psychologically and ritually. 3) Keep a personal ledger of completed practices to mirror celestial registration. 4) Separate ‘doing good’ from ‘claiming credit before Heaven’—both steps matter. 5) Use anniversary dates of major rites for re-declaration if cases reopen.
entries.logic_compare: It is the complementary opposite of the confession liturgy: one clears debit, the other posts credit. Unlike quietist texts that reject merit-talk, Lingbao insists merit accounting is soteriologically necessary.

entries.name_han: 洞玄靈寶自然券儀
entries.logic_thesis: The ‘natural covenant’ ritual proves that initiation is a legal-ontological contract with the Dao: by receiving the spontaneously formed bond (自然券), the adept’s identity is rewritten from ordinary subject to registered spiritual agent, enabling later rites to take effect.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Without covenant, humans remain outside the Lingbao administrative network. 2) The natural bond is not invented by humans but disclosed through correct rite. 3) Once bonded, the person may handle scriptures, talismans, and salvation work. 4) Breaking the bond voids authority and invites reverse sanction. 5) Therefore transmission is contractual causality, not club membership. 6) Conclusion: status change precedes power use.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Treat vows and precepts as binding fate contracts—chart luck shifts after real ordination/commitment. 2) Before advanced methods, establish a clear covenant (teacher, precept, daily rule). 3) Diagnose self-sabotage after broken vows as contract backlash, not only elemental weakness. 4) Renew covenants at major BaZi luck-pillar transitions. 5) Do not mix incompatible lineages without understanding conflicting ‘bonds’.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike mind-seal texts that prove transmission by inner recognition alone, this proves transmission by formal covenant-instrument. It is more legalistic than *紫元君授道傳心法* and more initiatory than general confession liturgies.

entries.name_han: 太上洞淵三昧神咒齋懺謝儀
entries.logic_thesis: This Dongyuan rite proves that demonic disaster and disease are court cases opened by hidden faults and invasive forces; the samādhi-spell fast of confession-apology (懺謝) dissolves the case by combining purified mind-state (三昧), spoken authority (神咒), and restitution.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Calamities have agents (demons, plague officers) activated by human disorder. 2) Ordinary medicine/politics treat symptoms, not the case file. 3) Confession plus apology reopens negotiation with those agents. 4) God-spells spoken from samādhi carry jurisdictional force. 5) Therefore crisis response must be multi-layer: mind, speech, rite, amends. 6) Conclusion: exorcism without 懺謝 is incomplete prosecution defense.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When BaZi shows sudden ‘killings’ or illness stars peaking, audit ethical breaches and environmental/spiritual hygiene. 2) Pair medical care with apology practices to people/places harmed. 3) Use mantra only after calming into unified mind—spell without samādhi is noise. 4) For family cluster disasters, do collective 懺謝, not only individual chart tweaks. 5) Re-check chart timing after the rite; if pattern softens, the case logic is confirmed.
entries.logic_compare: More apotropaic and crisis-oriented than general Lingbao 度人 cosmology. Compared with the pure ‘direction confession’ of 玉匱明真, Dongyuan emphasizes demonological courtroom logic and spell-power under fasting conditions.

entries.name_han: 太上洞淵三昧神咒齋十方懺儀
entries.logic_thesis: The ten-directions confession proves that guilt and protection are omnidirectional: because harmful forces and witnesses occupy all spatial quarters, incomplete directional coverage leaves loopholes; full ten-direction 懺 seals the entire sphere of the person or community.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Space is administratively partitioned into ten directions with officers and observers. 2) Fault and attack can come from any partition. 3) One-sided repentance covers only one lawsuit venue. 4) Ten-direction sequence systematically closes every venue. 5) Therefore thoroughness of spatial liturgy equals thoroughness of karmic quarantine. 6) Conclusion: geometry of rite is geometry of safety.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In major luck crises, do not rely on a single ‘lucky direction’ remedy; review all life domains (N/S/E/W as career/home/relations/wealth metaphors). 2) Physically or meditatively bow/confess toward ten directions to embody completeness. 3) Map BaZi twelve palaces onto a spherical check—ignore no house. 4) For house fengshui + BaZi cases, clear all sectors, not only the obvious sha. 5) Use the ten-direction model as a QA checklist after any large ritual.
entries.logic_compare: It specializes the broader Dongyuan confession into a spatial completeness theorem. Unlike single-altar generic rites, its unique logical claim is that partial coverage is structurally insufficient against omnidirectional spiritual jurisdiction.

entries.name_han: 靈寶五經提綱
entries.logic_thesis: The outline of the five Lingbao scriptures proves that the massive canon is one machine with five interlocking functions; without grasping the outline (提綱), practitioners drown in text and lose the operative logic that makes each scripture a module of salvation technology.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Lingbao corpus is vast and easily fragmented into superstition or scholasticism. 2) Five core scriptures encode complementary functions (cosmogony, precepts, ritual, salvation, body-method, etc.—as framed by the outline). 3) Outline shows dependencies: which module presupposes which. 4) Correct study order restores systemic power. 5) Therefore pedagogy is part of soteriology. 6) Conclusion: meta-structure is a spiritual method.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When learning BaZi classics, build a five-module map (structures, images, luck cycles, events, remedy) instead of random tips. 2) Always identify which ‘scripture function’ a technique belongs to before using it. 3) Teach clients a simple outline of their chart before details. 4) Revisit outlines yearly as luck pillars change. 5) Resist collecting techniques that do not plug into your system map.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike primary scriptures that prove content, this text proves architecture. It is a scholastic-operational key similar to ‘提纲’ genres, differing from narrative histories (*歷代崇道記*) by focusing on internal canon logic rather than external patronage history.

entries.name_han: 歷代崇道記
entries.logic_thesis: The chronicle of successive dynasties’ veneration of the Dao proves that political legitimacy and national fortune rise and fall with correct honor of the Dao; history itself is empirical evidence that Heaven responds to collective religious-political alignment.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Dynasties that honor authentic Daoist order enjoy stability signs. 2) Neglect, persecution, or false cults correlate with disorder. 3) Recording these correlations teaches rulers and communities a causal lesson. 4) Therefore ‘崇道’ is statecraft and fatecraft at civilizational scale. 5) Individual cultivation is nested inside this larger response pattern. 6) Conclusion: historiography is apologetics with predictive intent.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read national/year pillars with attention to collective religious-ethical climate, not only markets. 2) For personal charts, note how institutional affiliation (company, state, sect) modulates luck. 3) Support legitimate transmission structures as long-term luck infrastructure. 4) Avoid cynical manipulation of ‘Dao’ branding—historical pattern punishes counterfeit honor. 5) Use historical case studies when advising leaders with strong Authority/Power stars.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike liturgical manuals proving micro-causal rites, this proves macro-causal politics. It differs from *廣黃帝本行記* by surveying many reigns rather than one culture-hero, making the argument statistical-historical rather than purely archetypal.

entries.name_han: 太上洞神太元河图三元仰谢仪
entries.logic_thesis: This Dongshen liturgy proves that thanks-giving (仰谢) to the Three Primes via Hetu numerology is necessary completion of received blessings: unacknowledged gifts remain unstable, while properly oriented gratitude re-stabilizes the three-yuan cycles governing body, fate, and world.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Blessings descend through three-prime temporal structures and Hetu-number gates. 2) Receiving without acknowledgment creates imbalance in the gift-circuit. 3) 仰谢 orients body and speech upward to the correct officers of the three primes. 4) Numerological timing ensures the thank-you hits the same gate that gave. 5) Therefore gratitude is technical reciprocity, not only emotion. 6) Conclusion: fate maintenance requires periodic closed-loop thanks.
entries.logic_practice: 1) After a luck peak (promotion, recovery), schedule a formal thanksgiving practice—don’t only pray in crisis. 2) Align thanks with san-yuan / major period boundaries when possible. 3) In BaZi, treat Resource stars as ‘received gifts’ needing ethical and ritual reciprocity. 4) Teach clients a gratitude-action pair (donate, serve, rite) to lock gains. 5) Use Hetu-inspired spatial orientation if trained; otherwise use sincere upward dedication as minimal form.
entries.logic_compare: Where confession rites clear debts, this rite stabilizes credits through thanks. It is more calendar-numerological (Hetu, three primes) than the Jade Casket Lingbao pair, linking Dongshen cosmic math to emotional-political gratitude.

entries.name_han: 灵宝净明天枢都司法院须知法文
entries.logic_thesis: The Jingming ‘court of the celestial pivot’ must-know text proves that salvation work is a judicial bureaucracy: without knowing the codes, offices, and procedures of the Tianshu Court, the adept’s petitions are procedurally invalid even if sincere.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Jingming frames the cosmos as a lawful court system centered on the celestial pivot. 2) Human suffering often equals unresolved spiritual-legal cases. 3) Only petitions that meet formal requirements move the court. 4) ‘须知’ materials prevent fatal procedural errors. 5) Therefore knowledge of process is compassion’s instrument. 6) Conclusion: administrative literacy is soteriological skill.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Write fate remedies as clear case files: facts, faults, requests, evidence of amends. 2) Keep ethical purity requirements of Jingming (loyalty, filiality, humility) as standing ‘court etiquette.’ 3) Do not improvise titles/talismans you are not authorized to use. 4) For lawsuit-heavy BaZi patterns, combine worldly legal diligence with spiritual-procedural diligence. 5) Study office hierarchies so prayer addresses the right function, not a vague ‘Heaven.’
entries.logic_compare: More explicitly judicial-administrative than general Lingbao 度人 pathos. Compared with Dongyuan demon-court crisis rites, Jingming emphasizes standing court procedure and Confucianized ethics as permanent operating system.

entries.name_han: 灵宝净明院教师周真公起请画一
entries.logic_thesis: Zhou Zhengong’s standardized proposals prove that a living teaching order must convert charismatic inspiration into uniform rules (畫一): without institutional ‘one-stroke’ standards, Jingming practice fractures and loses court-recognized efficacy.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Early communities suffer variance in ritual and ethics. 2) Variance produces disputes, invalid rites, and loss of public trust. 3) A teacher’s 起请 (formal proposals) crystallizes norms. 4) 畫一 (uniformity) makes training, ordination, and discipline decidable. 5) Therefore institutional standardization protects salvation technology. 6) Conclusion: rule-making is part of the Dao’s compassionate skillful means.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Codify your personal/family cultivation SOPs—times, precepts, review cycles. 2) In BaZi schools, standardize chart notation and ethics of prediction to reduce harm. 3) Prefer clear written agreements with clients/disciples over vague spiritual authority. 4) Periodically revise standards like 起请—living law, not fossil law. 5) Measure community health by consistency of practice, not only peak mystical experiences.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike mythic revelation scriptures, this is meta-institutional logic: it proves form-standardization. It differs from *须知法文* by focusing on teacher-initiated policy proposals rather than court cosmology per se, though both serve Jingming order.

entries.name_han: 明真破妄章頌
entries.logic_thesis: The verses prove that true illumination (明真) is achieved by actively smashing delusions (破妄): false gods, false methods, and false interpretations are not harmless mistakes but causal obstacles that divert qi and merit; dialectic refutation is itself a liberating technique.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Beings suffer because they invest belief-energy in unreal structures. 2) Those structures can be exposed by reasoned and inspired critique. 3) Once seen through, the invested energy returns to the true. 4) Hymnic/versified form implants anti-delusion memes in memory. 5) Therefore polemics can be soteriology. 6) Conclusion: clarity is a weapon and a medicine.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Audit BaZi marketplace myths (fatalism, one-star fixes, fear selling) and cut them from practice. 2) For each prediction, ask ‘what would falsify this?’—破妄 as method. 3) Replace vague spiritual fear with testable cultivation metrics. 4) Recite or journal refutations of your own recurring self-delusions. 5) Teach clients model uncertainty honestly; honesty is 明真.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike initiation covenants that create positive bonds, this text creates negative capability: the power to refuse. It is closer to Buddhist abhidharma polemic energy inside a Daoist ‘true vs false’ frame, differing from purely devotional Lingbao hymnody.

entries.name_han: 玄精碧匣靈寶聚玄經
entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that mysterious essence (玄精) can be gathered (聚玄) into a contained vessel (碧匣): salvation and immortality require a technology of collection and storage of pre-cosmic essence, not only ethical purity or outer petition.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Primordial mystery disperses into phenomena and is lost to ordinary life. 2) Lingbao methods provide a ‘jasper casket’—symbolic and practical containment. 3) Gathering re-concentrates usable 玄精 for transformation. 4) Without storage, momentary insights and qi peaks leak away. 5) Therefore container-logic (body seals, altar seals, mind seals) is central. 6) Conclusion: aggregation is the key operation of this text’s soteriology.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Build daily ‘collection windows’ (meditation, breath, sleep hygiene) as your 碧匣. 2) In BaZi, strong output without resource/storage stars needs container practices (boundaries, savings, secrecy of plans). 3) After rituals, sit to gather residual qi rather than immediately dispersing in talk. 4) Use journals/talismanic discipline as external caskets for intention. 5) Avoid over-sharing mystical gains—leakage of 玄.
entries.logic_compare: More essence-collection oriented than confession/merit liturgies. Compared with *大洞金華玉經*’s light-flower, this emphasizes casket-containment of mysterious essence; compared with *真龍虎九仙經*, less stepwise dual-pole combat, more treasury-gathering.

entries.name_han: 太上洞玄靈寶三一五氣真經
entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that the Three Ones and Five Qi are the minimal complete operating system of the human-microcosm: if the three unities are held and the five qi ordered, destiny stabilizes because the person reenacts the cosmogonic assembly of the Dao in the body.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Cosmos arises through ordered differentiation of ones and five-phase qi. 2) Humans are the same structure in miniature. 3) Disorder of the three/five is illness, bad fate, and spiritual deafness. 4) Scripture provides the true names and methods to re-seat the Three Ones and sequence Five Qi. 5) Therefore body-cosmology is the root layer under ritual and ethics. 6) Conclusion: microcosmic administration precedes successful petition to macrocosmic administration.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Map BaZi five elements directly onto five-qi cultivation (seasonal living, organ time, emotion regulation). 2) Practice ‘holding the Three Ones’ as triple unity of essence-qi-spirit or heaven-earth-man in daily stillness. 3) Correct elemental excess/deficiency in chart with corresponding qi lifestyle before exotic rites. 4) Use 子丑丑… hours strategically for gathering specific qi. 5) Evaluate remedies by whether five-phase rhythm in the body calms, not only by external events.
entries.logic_compare: More physiological-cosmological than Jingming court procedure or Dongyuan exorcism. It differs from pure neidan dragon-tiger texts by using classical ‘Three Ones / Five Qi’ Lingbao-Shangqing body gods framework rather than Song-Yuan lead-mercury poetry alone.

entries.name_han: 太上清靜元洞真文玉字妙經
entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that purity-stillness (清靜) is the condition under which primordial cavern true-graphs (真文玉字) become legible and effective; without quietude, the jade characters remain inert ink, so calm is epistemic and causal access to the Dao’s code.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Reality’s deepest layer is encoded as true writ / jade graphs. 2) Agitated mind cannot interface with that code. 3) 清靜 purifies the channel of perception and authority. 4) Once still, recitation/visualization of the graphs reprograms fate-nodes. 5) Therefore stillness is not withdrawal from efficacy but its prerequisite. 6) Conclusion: ontology (true writ) + phenomenology (stillness) = method.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Begin every BaZi reading with minutes of 清靜 to avoid projection. 2) Treat meditation as decoding practice for your own chart’s ‘true text.’ 3) When luck is chaotic, prioritize nervous-system stillness over stacking more talismans. 4) Recite short true-writ sequences only after quieting—quality over volume. 5) Use purity precepts (less noise, less toxicity) as hardware for the software of 玉字.
entries.logic_compare: Complements *度人* graph-cosmology by stressing the subjective access condition (清靜). Unlike *明真破妄*’s aggressive refutation, this proves by subtraction of noise. Unlike covenant rites, power here hinges on state of mind more than legal status—though classical practice often combines both.

entries.name_han: 太上洞玄靈寶天關經
entries.logic_thesis: The Heavenly Pass scripture proves that fate is gated: between realms and between life-stages stand ‘天關’ checkpoints controlled by cosmic mechanism; cultivation and ritual succeed when they know how to request, time, and pass these gates rather than battering blindly against closed bars.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Movement of qi, souls, and petitions is not free-flow but gated. 2) Gates open on lawful times and with lawful credentials. 3) Ignorance of passes causes stalled cultivation, trapped souls, failed rites. 4) Scripture reveals the map and protocol of the Heavenly Pass. 5) Therefore timing + authorization + correct approach = transit. 6) Conclusion: destiny change is a gate-navigation problem.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Treat luck-pillar boundaries, solar terms, and eclipse/node periods as gate times for major decisions or rites. 2) In charts, identify ‘blocked gate’ patterns (void, heavy seals, repeated failed starts) and apply patience + credential-building (merit, skill, precept). 3) For ancestral salvation logic, visualize/work the pass of the dead with proper rites rather than only grief. 4) Do not force breakthroughs when multiple gates are closed; accumulate keys. 5) After passing a life gate (degree, marriage, recovery), do 言功/仰谢 to keep the way from slamming shut.
entries.logic_compare: More explicitly about transit mechanics than general salvation (*度人*) or confession. It differs from *三一五氣真經*’s internal assembly by focusing on thresholds between states/realms; together they form interior order vs portal passage—two complementary logics of Lingbao body-cosmos engineering.
